newsitem.title: THAILAND: Bangkok Bank cuts lending rate by 25 bps.
newsitem.headline: Bangkok Bank cuts lending rate by 25 bps.

text.p: Bangkok Bank, Thailand's largest commercial bank, said on Tuesday it would cut its minimum lending rate by 25 basis points to 13.00 percent, effective on May 2.
It also cut deposit rate of all time deposits by 25 basis points to be effective on May 2, a bank official said.
But the bank kept its minimum overdraft rate and minimum retail rate unchanged at 13.25 percent and 13.00 percent respectively.
The cut followed a signal by the Bank of Thailand that the time may be right for interest rate to be lowered to jump start the sagging economy.
Three other major banks --Siam Commercial Bank, Krung Thai Bank and Thai Farmers Bank -- also announced cuts on Monday.
